oracle.requirement_contract: Eine Änderung von language oder normative_force MUSS als Fachinhaltsänderung nach dem bestehenden Lifecycle- und Kontextbindungsvertrag behandelt werden.
oracle.scope: Actual native draft and structurally stored approved Requirement updates. Language/force/text changes receive common content/revision handling; approved changes become proposed, including removal of an approved-only field. These fixtures do not attest historic approval legitimacy or downstream review/evidence currentness; public CLI and release claims remain open.

preconditions: An explicit complete local Goal/Requirement TargetModel and actual project files, registered native host authority, declared actor/time/IDs and matching revision or canonical hash.
steps: Change requirement language, normative_force or statement through ordered field options, a saved RFC-6902 array or explicit binary stdin.
Publish through the common full planner, lifecycle/metadata and real native transaction.
Check the resulting content hash, exactly one new revision, explicit updated audit, unchanged identity/creation audit, other bytes/modes and verified native completion.
Update structurally stored approved requirements (language, force, statement and removal of approved-only rationale), then check proposed, exactly one revision and durable native completion.
Bind the native lifecycle gate to the original operation/model/metadata and recompute it at each full-target check; no permissive replacement gate supplies the proposed-state evidence.
